# PROCESS — iteration cand_0002 (parent cand_0001, val 0.560)

Fanned out 6 read-only diagnosis subagents (one per group of failing trajectories) over ALL 22
failing traces of cand_0001, plus a dedicated agent on the two tasks cand_0001 REGRESSED (50051,
58147). Separated environment/infra faults and genuine logic-misreads (not prose-fixable) from the
prose-fixable clusters, then authored ADDITIVE / NARROWING edits into the existing prompt sections
(no new preamble pile-up).

## Ranked clusters (leverage = #tasks × recoverable)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **REGRESSION**: legacy CSE array formula reimplemented as literals | 50051 | last iter's "array over {…}" wording made the agent literalize `SMALL(IF(...))`, whose hand-rolled blank/tie logic diverged; legacy arrays recalc fine | CONFLICT/NARROW | narrow formula rule |
| 2 | **REGRESSION**: XML/zip surgery to satisfy no-outside-change check | 58147 (also 59667 crash, 56427) | verify "no cell outside changed" tripped on benign openpyxl re-serialization → agent hand-edited xlsx XML → LibreOffice couldn't recalc | STRUCTURE | reframe check to VALUES + ban XML surgery |
| 3 | blank-test `<>""` / boolean formula left live | 59743 (+53367) | `<>""` misfires under LibreOffice (empty→0); boolean/array-text formulas don't recalc; carried user's `IF(F>=0,…,"")` guard | KNOWLEDGE | extend literalize family |
| 4 | coverage self-check counts formula strings | 56637 | counted 146/146 formula strings, but `""`-branch cells collapse to empty after recalc (91 filled) | STRUCTURE | count evaluated values |
| 5 | text sentinel in numeric range | 55931 | wrote `"New"` for unmatched rows → 8 str-where-int | CONTRACT/NARROW | no invented text label |
| 6 | split-out piece converted to datetime/number | 50630, 325-44 | split/extract pieces written as datetime / coerced to int (dropping leading zeros); GT is text | KNOWLEDGE | worked example |
| 7 | kept pre-filled "Expected Output" value | 5192 | code only wrote when cell empty → kept demo value in B2 | KNOWLEDGE | overwrite-every-cell rule |
| — | NOT prose-fixable (logic-misread of ambiguous spec) | 3911, 11842, 57090, 59259, 57232, 39046, 51359, 110-2, 450-9, 30709 | grader has one intended interpretation of an under-specified multi-step spec; fixing = hardcoding the answer → overfit/fail gate | out of scope | skipped |
| — | ENVIRONMENT fault | 56996 | price source table is entirely `=RANDBETWEEN(...)`; any lookup is non-deterministic under recalc — unsolvable | infra | handed back |

## Edits made (all ADDITIVE or NARROWING; integrated into existing sections)
1. **prompt.md formula block** — rewrote into SAFE-to-keep vs MUST-literalize. Legacy CSE array formulas (SMALL(IF()), MAX(IF()), array INDEX/MATCH) explicitly SAFE and preferred as formulas; `_xlfn.` prefix is the tell for the modern spill functions that must be literalized. This NARROWS the literalize set (fewer things forced to literal). [rank 1]
2. **prompt.md formula block** — added MUST-literalize clause for `<>""`/`=""` blank-tests, boolean-returning formulas, and boolean SUMPRODUCT-over-text; plus "don't carry a broken `IF(…,\"\")` guard leaving \"\" in a numeric cell." [rank 3]
3. **task_template.md verify step 3 (formula check)** — aligned with #1/#2: legacy arrays kept; `_xlfn.`/volatile/`<>""`/boolean → recompute literal; split-out piece stays text. [rank 1/3/6]
4. **task_template.md verify step 3 (count check)** — count what formulas EVALUATE to, not formula strings; a `""`-branch cell is EMPTY after recalc. [rank 4]
5. **task_template.md verify step 3 (outside-range check)** — compare VALUES not openpyxl representation; benign re-serialization of untouched cells is fine; NEVER hand-edit xlsx XML/zip; always use a normal openpyxl save. [rank 2]
6. **prompt.md save line** — reinforce "write with a normal `wb.save(output_path)`; do not hand-edit XML/zip." [rank 2]
7. **prompt.md type block** — numeric answer range: real number in every cell; do NOT invent a text sentinel unless the instruction explicitly permits a token ("may be '-'"/"'#N/A'"). [rank 5]
8. **prompt.md type block** — worked SPLIT/EXTRACT example: every extracted piece stays TEXT even if it looks like a date, even if the instruction mentions the year/format; convert only when told to convert/parse/standardise. [rank 6]
9. **prompt.md re-run block** — COMPUTE AND OVERWRITE every answer cell; don't skip a cell that already holds a value (pre-filled sample value is wrong for hidden inputs). [rank 7]

## Verify-the-fix (trace → edit → new behavior) + blast radius
- **50051** trace reimplemented `SMALL(IF(...))` as literals ("avoids hardcoding T2:T600"), dropped a value and shifted the sequence → edit 1/3 name legacy arrays SAFE and say prefer the corrected FORMULA → agent keeps/repairs the array formula, recalcs to the intended result. BOUNDED: 47741 (fixed last iter) uses `_xlfn.TEXTJOIN` → still literalized; no passing task literalizes a legacy array.
- **58147** trace tripped its own "outside range" assertion on openpyxl re-serialization, then hand-edited the xlsx zip → LibreOffice couldn't recalc (grader labeled it INFRA). Edit 5/6 → check compares values, XML surgery banned → agent uses `wb.save`. Same XML-surgery trigger appeared in 59667 (crashed) and 56427. BOUNDED: all passing tasks already use openpyxl.save; edit only relaxes a check + bans a path none of them use.
- **59743** trace emitted `=IF(F>=0,F-IF(M<>"",M,IF(J<>"",J,0)),"")` — `M<>""` is TRUE for blank under Calc so it never subtracts J, and the `""` guard leaves text. Edit 2 → agent computes F−J/F−M/F in Python and writes numbers. BOUNDED: additive; no passing task uses `<>""` blank-tests.
- **56637** trace verified 146/146 by counting formula strings; `""` branches collapsed to 91 after recalc. Edit 4 → count evaluated values, `""`=empty → agent sees the shortfall and fills real values. BOUNDED: passing tasks already fill fully; stricter count only.
- **55931** trace wrote `"New"` (str) into 8 unmatched cells of an int column. Edit 7 → numeric range needs real numbers, no invented sentinel. BOUNDED/NARROWING: passing numeric tasks already write numbers; the "unless instruction permits a token" carve-out protects any task whose GT sentinel was asked for.
- **50630** trace wrote a real datetime for the split-out due-date piece (GT str); **325-44** coerced split tokens to int (dropping leading zeros; GT text). Edit 8 worked example pins split→text even for date-looking pieces / when the instruction mentions the year ("DATE WILL BE 2021"). BOUNDED: reinforces the existing verb-conditioned rule; convert-tasks (51958 → real date) unaffected because the example is scoped to SPLIT/EXTRACT.
- **5192** trace only wrote when the answer cell was empty, so it kept the pre-filled demo `1456CH02` in B2. Edit 9 → overwrite every cell → agent recomputes B2. BOUNDED: passing tasks overwrite already; additive. (5192's underlying transform rule is also ambiguous, so this may not fully pass — claimed only as the demo-copy fix.)

## Deliberately skipped (and why)
- **Logic-misreads** 3911, 11842, 57090, 59259, 57232, 39046, 51359, 110-2, 450-9, 30709 — the agent computes a plausible but different interpretation of an under-specified spec; the grader has one intended algorithm. No GENERAL rule closes the gap without encoding the task's specific answer (overfits, fails the held-out gate). Several partially benefit from edits 3/4/7 (type/coverage) but the core interpretation is out of prompt scope.
- **56427** — has BOTH a type miss (numeric-looking text copied as text; GT float) AND a coverage shortfall on hidden inputs. The type half conflicts with the split→text rule (a genuine "is this value numeric-in-nature?" ambiguity) and coverage would still fail, so no clean safe general rule; left to the general type/coverage nudges.
- **56996** — ENVIRONMENT fault: the lookup source is entirely `=RANDBETWEEN(...)`, non-deterministic under recalc. Unsolvable by any prompt edit; handed back.

## Process & safety
- 6 parallel read-only `Explore` diagnosis subagents; edits authored serially into one candidate (small, non-conflicting — no worktrees).
- Built on cand_0001's ACCEPTED RESULT: kept its high-value rules (re-run-on-hidden-inputs, narrow formula rule, verb-conditioned type rule, verify checklist). Did NOT re-try anything it broke — instead REPAIRED the two regressions it caused (50051 via edit 1, 58147 via edit 5).
- No infra/adapter/scorer/benchmark edits. All load-bearing placeholders in task_template.md preserved.

## Preserve next iteration
- The SAFE-vs-MUST-literalize split (legacy arrays kept; only `_xlfn.`/volatile/blank-test/boolean literalized) — do NOT collapse it back into a blanket "array → literal" (that regressed 50051).
- The values-not-representation outside-range check + XML-surgery ban (fixed 58147; XML surgery appeared in ≥3 traces).
